cleaningTypes.name: Periodic Relaxation Cycle
cleaningTypes.targetMechanism: Cessation of suction while air scouring shears loose reversible cake solids off fiber surface

cleaningTypes.name: Permeate Backpulse Flush
cleaningTypes.targetMechanism: Reversal of flow to dislodge internal pore constriction and surface cake matrix
cleaningTypes.effectivenessMetric: Backpulse pressure differential and immediate permeability reset

cleaningTypes.name: Maintenance Clean (Sodium Hypochlorite)
cleaningTypes.targetMechanism: Oxidation and solubilization of organic extracellular polymeric substances (EPS), biofilms, and pore foulants
cleaningTypes.effectivenessMetric: Recovery of Lp_20 towards pre-fouled baseline (>80% recovery target)

cleaningTypes.name: Maintenance Clean (Citric Acid)
cleaningTypes.targetMechanism: Chelation and dissolution of inorganic scaling (calcium phosphate, calcium carbonate, iron precipitates)
cleaningTypes.effectivenessMetric: Recovery of permeability lost to mineral scaling

cleaningTypes.name: Intensive Clean-In-Place (CIP)
cleaningTypes.chemical: Sequential NaOCl (1500 ppm) + Citric Acid (5000 ppm)
cleaningTypes.targetMechanism: Full chemical soak and recirculation to restore irreversible fouling and return membrane resistance near clean Rm
cleaningTypes.effectivenessMetric: Clean water permeability restoration (>90% of virgin module Rm)
